pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + any sword. The exact sword is equipped on release.
Starts waiting; select Fight. Equip a sword, shield, and $(l:care/armor)Slime Armor$(). The bag has normal Capacity. It uses normal melee and shield rules, spending one stamina per successful hit.

Targets has six filters. Only Hostile starts enabled; Neutral, Passive, Players, Tamed, and Creepers start off. Owners and allies stay excluded. Assigned enemy players use Hostile, with PvP protection. An Enderman targeting a living companion also uses Hostile until it disengages.

Vanilla Slimes only target companions that attack them. Combat and Dragon Slimes can still attack them first with Hostile enabled. It collects loot from its kills. Full cargo does not stop combat; carriers can unload it while its combat order remains active.
